result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d give people a deeper, more consistent capacity for empathy — not just feeling for others, but genuinely understanding their experiences and needs.

Many of the world’s hardest problems — conflict, inequality, neglect, environmental harm — become more solvable when people can truly consider the impact of their choices on others. Greater empathy wouldn’t erase every disagreement, but it would make cooperation, compassion, and long-term thinking far more natural.
